thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: NPZ selected member feeds NPY header, shape, payload and consumer projection; MHR routes are separately scoped in prior packet.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: NpyShape, NpyDimension, NpyElementCount, NpyPayloadLength and distinct archive/member types own different meanings.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Version-specific framing and checked payload shape precede array publication; resource/CRC and consumer numeric admission remain separate.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Checked shape/payload arithmetic and selected native framing narrow F091, while declared-size usize reservation remains policy-qualified.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Private NPY shape/dtype/payload and borrowed selected ZIP member retain coherent state; external tensor/layout/decoded-data policies remain separate.
thirteen_lenses.wrong-duplicate-owners: rawzip owns ZIP framing, NumPy owns dictionary/layout, MHR owns corrective semantics; shared words do not establish duplicate owner.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Declared decoded size is unverified central metadata, not an independently certified actual payload length.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Keep explicit supported version/dtype/order policy, scalar/zero dimensions, first-match selection and generic special float words; no legacy fallback required.
thirteen_lenses.enum-state-shape: Dtype, header field/order, compression and errors model finite native choices; open member names and payload values remain open.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Private coherent array and checked shape require real admission; derive selection alone cannot enforce aggregate contracts.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Archive declarations, decoded byte lengths, dimensions, element counts, rank and MHR indices are different quantities.
thirteen_lenses.raw-strings: NPY header keys and ZIP member paths are external format namespace; typed parsed roles and diagnostic context should not be mistaken for business identifiers.
thirteen_lenses.raw-primitives: Checked usize extent operations, u64 ZIP hints, native-width projection and floating conversion have different supported domains and policy owners.

limitations: No product archive parsing/processing, fixture creation, execution, simulation, tests, builds, probes, shader/device activity, repairs or publication/source edits. Evidence package archive extraction for hash verification and source text displays only.
